name: Caraway
summary: Caraway (Carum carvi) carries a Grade C rating — limited evidence. Strongest recorded design is a narrative review, drawn from 3 recorded studies, none of which measured an outcome in people. Recorded activity centres on digestive support and aromatic support, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include known allergy to Apiaceae family plants.
description: Caraway botanical profile with evidence, safety, and practical fit.
contraindications: known allergy to Apiaceae family plants such as celery parsley dill or fennel or a history of mugwort-celery-spice syndrome
pregnancy or breastfeeding in amounts beyond normal food use because safety data are lacking
anticoagulant or antihypertensive medication because caraway may have additive blood-thinning or blood-pressure-lowering effects
diabetes medication because caraway may have an additive blood-glucose-lowering effect
